verdict.rationale: Xero's reconciliation page says JAX, its AI finance partner, categorizes and matches transactions from connected bank accounts, which covers automatic categorization of imported transactions. Nothing in the evidence shows the suggestions learn from or adapt to user corrections, which is a core part of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of learning from user corrections, detail on how suggestions are presented and accepted, independent or hands-on corroboration of JAX categorization accuracy.
